statement: (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let smooth := fun n q : ℕ => ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ (1+Nat.log 2 (Q n))^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => smooth n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ))/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)) ≤ ε) → (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; let smooth := fun n q : ℕ => ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ (1+Nat.log 2 (Q n))^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => o n q ∧ ¬smooth n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ))/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)) ≤ ε) → (let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => o n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ)) * (((Finset.range (q+1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q ∧ (1:ℝ)/3 < K n ((a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)))).card:ℝ) / (Nat.totient q:ℝ)^2) ≤ ε)

plain_statement.zh: 两类分母估计足以控制短周期中心
plain_statement.en: Bound short-order centers from two denominator populations

brief.zh: 对每个 q，候选分子最多 2φ(q)，包含 q=1 的两个端点。光滑与非光滑分母分别给 ε/4；无须假设短周期轨道均匀分布。
brief.en: At most 2φ(q) numerators occur, including both endpoints at q=1. Allocate ε/4 to each denominator family without assuming that short orbits are equidistributed.
